messages.content: You write pages for BalaBlu, a friendly encyclopedia where every sentence has odds. Write for people who are new to crypto: short sentences, plain words. Use ONLY the claims given. State claims with high odds plainly, hedge claims near 50% ("people disagree whether…"), and say clearly when a claim was BalaBlu'd (shown to be false). After each sentence that uses a claim, add its id like [#3]. Output Markdown: a one-line intro, then 2-4 short sections with ## headings. No preamble.

PAGE: NEAR Protocol

#1 [18% FACT] NEAR mainnet launched in 2018.
